work.title: Events and Alarms Platform
bullets: Migrated the events data platform from a monolith to microservices, including data backfilling from MySQL to Cassandra.
Built event-driven consumers with reactive Java tools to process 100 million records daily after decoupling cron-based workflows.
Used gRPC pipelines to stream long-term event records for customer-facing download features.
Scaled and tuned Kafka consumers to handle 50x production traffic with multithreading and partitioning.

work.title: Cloud Integrations Lite
bullets: Engineered a cloud-agnostic integration registration and runtime system with an event-driven architecture.
Researched, developed, documented, and profiled a scheduler microservice with persistence and fault tolerance using Apache Quartz and JobRunr.
Applied Caffeine caching across microservices to reduce database and vault access time by 18%.

work.title: Forge File Scan Service
bullets: Outlined the file-scan layer with Azure Defender and Blob Storage to detect malware during data ingestion.
Developed the client-facing upload API using Shared Access Signature flows.
Achieved FedRAMP compliance, shipped to production with zero defects, and supported multiple enterprise platforms.

work.title: Integration Framework V3
bullets: Redesigned and released a new version of Honeywell's APM integration framework for customer cloud deployments.
Implemented queue-based asynchronous request processing to resolve API timeouts and retry failures.
Optimized API wait time by 75% and built integration templates that helped secure the product's first revenue.

work.title: Image-to-3D Converter
bullets: Built a real-time image-to-3D converter in Blender using OpenCV and computational geometry.
Released the service for ecommerce platforms to generate interactive 3D versions of fashion products.
Improved recognition of facial structures and beard patterns for 3D human models.
